identity: Legacy am identities remain valid. pm appends :pm before :catchup and :news; durable per-slot dispatch namespaces share one owner lock.
decision_cutoff: pm input publication, completed price and archive cutoffs are 16:00 UTC, including recovery. Acquisition receipts and final plan timestamps remain actual, never backdated.
population: Trading days: unchanged equities, ETFs and crypto. Weekends and US holidays: amended crypto only.
execution: Paper only; same tiers/sizes/caps. pm equity DAY market immediately after base plan final during regular session, strictly before close minus 15 minutes. Crypto market/gtc unchanged.
collisions: From pm activation, admit at most one new open or pending entry lot per asset/account across slots and directions. Existing lots remain unchanged and scored; prefer 1d to 5d, never refill a seen lot.

labels.entry: Prospective fixed pm anchor 17:30 UTC; on half days equity anchor is min(17:30 UTC, regular close minus 30 minutes). Base and news must finish before the same anchor. Execution fills and anchor gap scored separately as for am.
labels.equity_exit: Close of the nth complete following trading session (n=1 or 5); execution at that close minus five minutes, then overdue open sweep. Use exact 5-minute entry candle open and final 5-minute session candle close; never nearest-price fallback.
labels.crypto_exit: 17:30 UTC entry anchor plus 24/120 hours, same fixed-anchor elapsed-day convention as am; hourly :30 UTC exit timer.
labels.sources: Yahoo chart interval 5m for pm equity labels, bounded to 30 days; native timestamp/quote-array shape; public grant budgets unchanged per slot. Coinbase exact minute anchors unchanged.
labels.crypto_recovery: A bounded equity recovery anchor at :45 rounds crypto forward to the next UTC :30. Both arms finish before their earliest asset anchor. Every crypto 1d/5d exit remains on the existing hourly :30 timer; no early or late inferred candle.

recovery: One same-day retry for a FAILED or interrupted/missed pm primary without any decision/prediction. Frozen 16:00 input cutoff and original slot budget. A distinct recovery population uses a future :30 anchor in the following UTC hour, bounded by close minus 15 minutes for equities, or 23:30 UTC on closed days. Both arms must finish before that anchor. Equity exits still use nth full following session close; crypto anchor plus 24/120 hours. Exhausted budgets stay pending; no equity after-hours recovery.
monitoring: 15:15 UTC full-chain pm preflight, 15:45 conditional retry, daily successful model probes reused. Actual intents and plans audited after ten minutes, including missing pm run; failure alerts through existing notifier.
registration: Additive pm execution registration binds v4 journal and unchanged paper grant. No implicit migration; am binding/decisions/specs stay valid. pm refuses absent or mismatched registration.
scoring: am, pm and combined descriptive scores; existing am groups and primary test preserved. pm hypotheses exploratory; never pool am/pm in primary confirmatory test.
